document.abstract: Through the Army Pictorial Service the Signal Corps serves as teacher, historian, and ambassador for the United States Army. Day by day demands for motion pictures of the combat zones, training films, film-strips, English versions of United Nations training films, special films for morale purposes are growing by leaps and bounds.
